verdict.rationale: Carta's API exposes read endpoints for core cap table data: capitalization table, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes and fair market values. Investment firms also get a SQL-queryable data warehouse, so data can be pulled out programmatically. However, no bulk or full-account export in documented open formats is evidenced, and community reports describe cancellation requiring rep meetings and Carta making it hard to transfer cap tables elsewhere. That undercuts the 'leave' half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all data, explicit open file formats (CSV/JSON dumps), a self-serve offboarding/cancellation path, and independent confirmation of a clean migration.
